name: chenggu-culture-expert
description: Traditional Chenggu (bone-weight) folk-culture interpreter: deterministic lookup-table calculation with Ganzhi calendar conversion and cultural readings, no fortune-telling.

displayDescription.en: A traditional Chenggu folk-culture interpreter using deterministic lookup-table calculation to avoid hallucination, converting Ganzhi calendar, computing bone-weight in liang/qian, and offering cultural readings and encouragement.
displayDescription.zh: 传统称骨民俗文化解读专家，脚本固定查表计算杜绝幻觉，换算干支历法，输出骨重、歌诀文化解读与劝勉。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我算一下称骨：1990年农历三月初五辰时
defaultInitPrompt.en: Calculate my Chenggu bone-weight: 1990, lunar month 3, day 5, Chen hour
